svg.title: The comments of a contribution
svg.desc: Someone other than the maintainer or a bot comments on, reviews, pushes new commits to, reopens or makes ready for review an issue or a pull request of someone else. One of the maintainer or of a bot, the same event again and an ignored thing end there. A thing that is open names the comment, the review or the news in its message, edited in place, and one message below it in its topic notifies, once for a few quick ones; a draft that the maintainer asked for is written again for a comment or a review, while a text that they wrote themselves stays the draft. A thing whose reply went, or that GitHub dealt with, such as with a request for changes, opens again in its topic with Draft a reply, and an issue that the pager never showed comes as a new thing. When the maintainer comments or reviews on GitHub itself, or the issue or the pull request closes, the thing is done: its buttons go, and its topic gets a check mark.
